draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.00, the 124th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 17th of 35 at WR. He went 141st overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing standouts: three-cone (100th percentile), vertical jump (92nd percentile), broad jump (90th percentile). College production: 539 receiving yards in 2020, 24th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.
